policy: No beta release tag until every mandatory gate is verified with evidence

mandatory_gates.title: Identical .local/.de Final Master user experience
mandatory_gates.evidence: 15 automated GUI parity tests PASS for common navigation, status, telemetry, camera and push workers. Full Rooms/owner sharing panels still differ between .local and .de; tracked as GitHub issue #101. Visual parity not signed off.

mandatory_gates.title: Owner invitations, scoped roles, immediate revocation
mandatory_gates.evidence: 49 scoped backend/HTTP role, invitation, alert, automation, backup and gate tests passed 2026-11-16; delegated room-admin invite and revoke verified locally; Cloud guest access still unavailable

mandatory_gates.title: Guest sessions and room roles enforced on Cloud remote transport
mandatory_gates.evidence: Cloud owner-account memberships and guest WebSocket installed on Plesk; Cloud room-invite landing/login/redeem/view deployed 2026-11-16 (20/20 Cloud file parity). 33 isolated guest WebSocket/ACL tests, 19 GUI/source tests, one simulated complete JS guest join smoke passed. Late replies after revocation are suppressed by reserved guest request IDs. Two real Cloud accounts, owner invite UI, role changes and device-based acceptance still require verification. 2026-11-16: 38 Cloud membership/guest WebSocket/ACL tests passed; listings now exclude disabled guest accounts and live guest transport is identified accurately. Updated Cloud module deployed, HTTPS 200, unauthenticated membership request 401. Two real account and role-revocation iPhone acceptance still open.

mandatory_gates.title: Explicit-consent Cloud iOS Web Push, revoked-member stop, recovery and quiet hours
mandatory_gates.evidence: Local opt-in code and push-only Cloud worker exist; authenticated Cloud registration and VAPID live test still missing

mandatory_gates.title: Light/fan scheduling and control with real hardware fail-safe tests
mandatory_gates.evidence: Room automation preview uses fresh data, no device writes; Mars Hydro currently disconnected

mandatory_gates.title: Create room/plant, calibrate soil probe, log reading and camera photo
mandatory_gates.evidence: Local room and camera regressions passed, authenticated multiuser E2E incomplete

mandatory_gates.title: Fresh Pi4 image, first boot, backup/restore and rollback
mandatory_gates.evidence: Read-only Pi room/reference/SQLite/photo integrity audit PASS on 2026-11-16 (1 room, 1 plant, 488+ measurements, 4 SQLite DBs); staging-only backup tested, fresh-image restore still not verified

mandatory_gates.title: Real iPhone PWA installed, alerts displayed and Cloud/Local visually accepted
mandatory_gates.evidence: Soil and camera screenshots accepted before later multiuser/push changes
